name: TPP riboswitch bound to thiamine pyrophosphate
affinitySource: Kulshina N et al. Nat Struct Mol Biol 2009, PMC2802028; Serganov et al. 2006
notes: TPP riboswitch from Escherichia coli thiM mRNA. Native ligand TPP (thiamine pyrophosphate). Aminopyrimidine stacks on A84; pyrophosphate tail contacts backbone P atoms of C91/G92. Complementary to 2GDI (different organism, native vs analog ligand). Both TPP structures together enable cross-validation of TPP pose prediction.

enrichmentSets.description: TPP riboswitch actives (thiamine/pyrophosphate analogs) vs property-matched decoys
enrichmentSets.source: Literature actives + RDKit property-matched decoys (Tanimoto<0.35 vs actives)
enrichmentSets.intendedUse: active-vs-decoy enrichment calibration for aptamer scoring terms

enrichmentSets.description: TPP riboswitch actives vs filtered non-nucleotide decoys (no P atoms, no nucleobase scaffolds). 2HOJ lacks Mg in receptor — use 2GDI for Mg-aware benchmark.
enrichmentSets.source: Literature actives (thiamine analogs) + ChEMBL property-matched decoys filtered to exclude P atoms and nucleobase scaffolds (no purines, pyrimidines, nucleosides, phosphates)
enrichmentSets.intendedUse: active-vs-decoy enrichment with nucleotide-chemotype decoys excluded

affinityNotes: TPP binds E. coli thiM riboswitch Kd ~198 nM at 0.5 mM Mg2+, ~9 nM at 2.5 mM Mg2+. Thiamine monophosphate ~30-fold weaker.
